opening.argument: The presentation announces Coinbase Business as an available business product and details ordinary commercial functions, including payments, invoicing, APIs, trading, and earning on crypto reserves. It also describes a customer payment workflow involving USDC transfers between platforms and a wallet, while the invoicing feature is expressly announced as part of the service. The invitation to business owners is a straightforward product-access instruction: “there's no application fees, no sales calls just go to coinbase dot com” followed by the business signup path. Claims about rewards and crypto checkout are presented as product or customer-use-case examples, while the description frames the material as informational rather than investment advice. These features and presentation context support treating the video as a business product announcement and service promotion.
